findings.text: follow-on: _recent repeats the stamp formatting of _instant at line 28 (the strftime prefix, the millisecond suffix and the +00:00 to Z swap) instead of parameterising one helper.

follow-on: the tests: field carries the placeholder PYTHONPATH=<worktree> rather than the literal command the contract requires; the authoritative literal command is present in after_suite so the evidence stands.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 40186023d; one commit fd7a0908c over three files -- the doctor binds the census roots at call time instead of through census's import-time default arguments, the census test is rebuilt to construct its own now-relative fixture and derive its expected lines, and the landing fragment is added.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when requires the id to pass on a node with live MCP connections, its expected line to come from its own fixture, the real configuration home to be unchanged, no added failure among the files importing reckon/mcp_census.py, and a negative control set one above the fixture's and logged under the run directory; the manifest records head "6 passed" (gate_head.log), base "1 failed, 5 passed" (baseline_suite.log) whose sole failure is test_doctor_prints_the_census_figures, and negative_control.log ending EXIT=1, and I re-ran the single named id and got "1 passed".
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to make the doctor pass a census log root a test can point at a temporary directory and have the test build the logs there and derive the expected line from them; reckon/project_maintenance_commands.py:1222-1226 now passes log_root=mcp_census.LOG_ROOT and transcript_root=mcp_census.TRANSCRIPT_ROOT at call time, and tests/test_mcp_census.py:256-386 builds its own connections and transcripts under tmp_path and computes every expected line from those records, so the goal is met.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, changed_paths matching the diff, head "6 passed", base "1 failed, 5 passed", negative_control EXIT=1, and baseline_suite/after_suite JSON carrying the literal commands and absolute log paths; its tests: line carries an unsubstituted PYTHONPATH=<worktree> placeholder (FINDING).
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared scope is reckon/mcp_census.py, reckon/project_maintenance_commands.py, tests/test_mcp_census.py, the fragment docs/.../census-test-reads-its-own-fixture.html and its figures directory; git diff --stat 40186023d..fd7a0908c lists exactly three files -- reckon/project_maintenance_commands.py, tests/test_mcp_census.py and the fragment -- every one inside the declaration, and reckon/mcp_census.py is declared but untouched.

justifications.durability: tests/test_mcp_census.py:385 asserts a line derived from the fixture records against census's output, and reverting the doctor to census's import-time defaults would leave the fixture uncensused and redden it, though the negative control mutates the expectation rather than the product.
justifications.evidence: gate_head.log records "6 passed / EXIT=0" and baseline_suite.log "1 failed, 5 passed / EXIT=1" on the same id, both reproduced in the manifest's suite JSON, reduced one for the placeholder standing in the manifest's tests: field.
justifications.fit: reckon/project_maintenance_commands.py:1218-1221 carries a mechanism comment on the call-time binding and no plan, stage or ticket token enters either file.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/project_maintenance_commands.py:1225-1226 passes log_root=mcp_census.LOG_ROOT and transcript_root=mcp_census.TRANSCRIPT_ROOT at call time, so the monkeypatch at tests/test_mcp_census.py:276-277 redirects the census.
justifications.reuse: the helper tests/test_mcp_census.py:248 duplicates the filename-stamp formatting already in _instant at tests/test_mcp_census.py:28; no production capability is forked and no owner outside this test file exists.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 40186023d..fd7a0908c lists only reckon/project_maintenance_commands.py, tests/test_mcp_census.py and the evidence fragment, all inside the declared write paths.
